data.plain: Reusing a cached result looked up by name, path, route, display label or producer after the content it was computed from has changed.

analogy.boundary: The picture covers one card; finding one wrong card does not tell you whether the rest of the catalogue is current.

maps.analogy: the catalogue card filed under the title and shelf
maps.doctrine: a saved result kept under a name that does not change

maps.analogy: the book on the shelf, swapped for a different edition
maps.doctrine: the content behind the name, which has changed

maps.analogy: checking the book on the shelf before trusting the card
maps.doctrine: keying reuse on a hash of the content

analogy.text: A library catalogue card says a title is on shelf B, but the book there was swapped for a different edition and nobody updated the card.

reader.counterexample: A page keeps serving a number from an unchanged route long after someone edited the source the number was computed from.
reader.does_not_prove: Catching one stale reuse at one hash check leaves every other cache unexamined, and the source records freshness tracking across the system as still incomplete.

example.text: The source-import protocol keys each imported copy on a content hash and refuses to reuse the copy when the source hash no longer matches, so a changed source cannot be served from its old path.

reader.governs: Any reuse of a saved result.
reader.plain: The mistake of reusing a saved answer filed under a name or address after the thing behind that name has been changed or replaced.
reader.potential_misread: That an unchanged name means unchanged content.
reader.refuses: Serving a saved result by name, path, route, label or producer after the inputs it was computed from have changed.
reader.requires: A cache key computed from a hash of the inputs, with a recompute or a refusal when the hash no longer matches.
reader.why_it_matters: Pipelines reuse saved results by name to save time, and when the source has been edited the name keeps returning an out-of-date answer without anyone noticing.
